name: bookends-compliance

scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/rules.js && npm test
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run photos:local
scripts.backup: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export bookends-compliance --remote --output backups/bookends-compliance-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).sql

description: Bookends Hospitality compliance dashboard: food safety (FSSAI) and maintenance audits, fix plans and licences. Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV.
